summary: Party of four backcountry skiers descending the north couloir on Quandary Peak; a second party of three dropped in above them despite being told their plan; the third skier triggered a wind-slab avalanche (8-12 in crown) that swept one of Trevor Carlson's party ~1,000 ft down the couloir and partially buried him; his own party dug him out - uninjured, skied out; the triggering party skied away without helping; Carlson filed a CAIC field report
notes: No agency SAR response - companion/party rescue; documented via national media + CAIC field report (4/21/2024 Vail & Summit County, Trevor Carlson). Precedent: ids 2776/2198 (avalanche self/companion rescues indexed). Inserted run 878. Merged run 901: SnowBrains 2024-04-21 north-couloir story (parent-opened, incident-matched).
